research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Dollar Shave Club is researching and developing shaving razor systems, as described in titles such as 'Razor cartridge' and 'Razor exposure.' The abstracts detail systems with razor handles that dock with cartridges using a single hook and spring-mounted pushrod, as well as cartridges featuring unitary frames with angled joints and multiple guards. These efforts focus on improving the design and functionality of razor handles and cartridges for personal grooming.

overview_description.description:
Dollar Shave Club is a lifestyle brand and e-commerce company that invents and delivers smart, affordable products to make lives easier. Through an exclusive R&D process that includes botanicals and chemists, the company makes all its own products at affordable prices.

Dollar Shave Club was founded in 2012 and is based in Santa Monica, California.

about_short_description.short_description: DSC is a lifestyle brand and e-commerce company that delivers razors and other personal grooming products to customers by mail.

product.name: Razors and Replacement Blades
product.description: Manual shaving systems including Signature 6 Blade, Classic 4 Blade, and Humble Twin razors, with compatible replacement cartridges for face and body shaving.

product.name: Dollar Shave Club Subscription Service
product.description: A recurring delivery service for blades, shave aids, and grooming products with adjustable shipment schedules and options to pause, modify, skip, or cancel.

product.name: Shave Aids and Post-Shave Care
product.description: Pre-shave, shaving, and post-shave products including Prep Scrub, Shave Butter, Shave Gel, Shave Cream, Post Shave Dew, Post Shave Cream, and Rescue Serum.

product.name: Electric Grooming Devices
product.description: Rechargeable electric grooming tools for facial, body, head, and detail trimming, including the For Your Face Electric Razor, For Your Beard Trimmer, For Your Body Trimmer, and For Your Head Shaver.

product.name: Women’s Shaving Products
product.description: Body-shaving products including the Women’s Signature 6 Blade, Wavy Grip Handle, Women’s Shave Oil, Women’s Shave Butter, Body Balm, Sugar Scrub, and shower storage accessories.

product.name: Skin and Body Care
product.description: Personal-care products including Hydrating Face Wash, Hydrating Body Wash, facial moisturizer, Eye Savior, antiperspirant, body bars, Deo Wipes, Ball Spray, and One Wipe Charlies Butt Wipes.
